summary_en: 400,000 shares (5.2% of shares outstanding), ¥100.0M upper limit. Open-market acquisition on Tokyo Stock Exchange. Period: Aug 17, 2026–May 31, 2027. Stated rationale: shareholder return enhancement and capital-efficiency improvement.
title_en: Notice Regarding Determination of Matters Concerning Acquisition of Treasury Stock
translation_en_brief: SecuAvail Inc. announced on 14 August 2026 that its board of directors resolved to acquire up to 400,000 shares of its own common stock, representing 5.2% of shares outstanding (computed as 400,000 ÷ 7,689,552 as of 31 July 2026). The acquisition will be conducted via open-market purchase on the Tokyo Stock Exchange between 17 August 2026 and 31 May 2027, with a total acquisition budget of up to ¥100.0 million. The company stated that the buyback is intended to enhance shareholder returns and improve capital efficiency, while enabling flexible capital policy execution in response to future changes in the business environment.
